summary: Iteration 5 tested the two new admin tabs: GitHub Activity Manager and Live Info Card Manager. Backend pytest (5/5 passing) validates /api/widgets public defaults, JWT-protected PUT /api/admin/widgets persistence, and POST /api/admin/github/sync timestamp update. Frontend Playwright validates login, both new tabs render, all data-testids present, username 'torvalds' persists after reload, Verify + Refresh + Save flows work, disabling the GitHub section hides it on '/', LiveInfo card disappears when disabled and repositions to bottom-left (x=24) when position=left. Regression check on all previously-existing admin tabs (overview, profile, skills, projects, appearance, seo, settings) confirmed no regression.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1300 lines and growing — recommend splitting into routers (widgets, admin, analytics) for maintainability.

PUT /api/admin/widgets replaces the sub-dicts (github/live_info) whole; partial updates are not supported. Frontend currently sends both keys so this works, but a shallow-merge on the server would be safer.
seed_data_creation: None. Test toggles were restored to original state after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GitHub Activity + Live Info admin tabs are fully functional and integrated with /api/widgets. Portfolio home ('/') correctly reads settings. Previous iteration_4 covered the rest of the CMS.
